[".venv/bin/python", "-c", "import json,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
rows=[]
for p in sorted(Path('docs/selftrained/results/public-cpu-raw').glob('*-result.json')):
 d=json.loads(p.read_text());out=Path(d['stdout_path']);out=out if out.exists() else Path('docs/selftrained/results/public-cpu-raw')/out.name
 actual=hashlib.sha256(out.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
 rows.append({'file':p.name,'chat':d['chat'],'returncode':d['returncode'],'stdout_hash_matches':actual==d['stdout_sha256'],'argv':d['argv']})
